data.title: Facebook accounts for 74% of online shopping scams
data.description: Facebook accounted for nearly three-quarters of reported online shopping scams in Thailand last week, with clothing, vehicles and travel services the most targeted categories, the Anti Cyber Scam Center (ACSC) reported.

data.title: Flood victims to get B10.5bn
data.description: The cabinet has approved 10.5 billion baht in central budget funding for fiscal 2027 to compensate flood victims, as the government introduces financial, tax and insurance measures to help affected households, farmers and businesses.

data.title: Campus shift plans set to go ahead
data.description: Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation Minister Yodchanan Wongsawat has confirmed plans to relocate Uthenthawai Campus despite student protests, pledging support to minimise disruption during the 90-day transition.

data.title: Potash mines aim to cut import reliance
data.description: The Industry Ministry is pushing potash mining projects to reduce dependence on fertiliser imports and generate more than 30 billion baht in annual export revenue.

data.title: Court hears witnesses in ethics case of former Move Forward Party MPs
data.description: Three witnesses testified at the Supreme Court on Tuesday in a case against 44 former Move Forward Party MPs accused of serious ethical violations for co-sponsoring a proposal to amend Section 112 of the Criminal Code, the lese-majeste law.

data.title: Illegal waste factories face crackdown
data.description: The government is coordinating efforts across ministries to crack down on illegal industrial waste operations in Prachin Buri, amid concerns over toxic pollution and forest encroachment.

data.title: Civil groups urge PM to drop 4 tax bills
data.description: Ten civil society networks have urged Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to withdraw four proposed bills after public consultations indicated strong opposition to changes in earmarked tax funding.

data.title: Fugitive tied to B220m theft collared
data.description: Immigration police have arrested a 41-year-old Chinese businessman wanted in his home country for alleged fraud and theft involving about 220 million baht, with more than 100 victims in Beijing.

data.title: Seoul eyes closer ties in AI, content
data.description: Thailand and South Korea could expand cooperation in artificial intelligence (AI) to improve logistics, automotive manufacturing and tourism services, speakers at a bilateral forum said on Tuesday.

data.title: Klatham future prompts rumours
data.description: The possibility of the Klatham Party joining the Bhumjaithai-led coalition after next week's no-confidence debate has fuelled speculation about a cabinet reshuffle.

data.title: B44m seized in gambling case against MP Chonnaput
data.description: The Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) has seized an additional 44 million baht in cash and digital assets linked to an online gambling network in which Klatham Party MP Chonnaput Naksua is accused of being a key figure.

data.title: Dinosaur footprints dating back 120 million years confirmed in Udon Thani
data.description: Paleontologists have confirmed that six fossilized footprints found in Udon Thani were left by a carnivorous dinosaur about 120 million years ago, and the site will be protected and developed for scientific study and tourism.

data.title: Boxer Somluck cleared of girl's rape, gets 2 years for lewd abduction
data.description: KHON KAEN - The Appeal Court on Tuesday cleared Olympic medallist boxer Somluck Kamsing of attempted rape, but sentenced him to two years in prison for abducting a minor for lewd purpose.

data.title: ‘Real’ Chinese tourists won’t face kidnap risk, says minister
data.description: Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul has responded to a new Chinese travel advisory about the risk of kidnapping in Thailand, saying genuine tourists would never be targeted by criminal gangs.

data.title: Investigators question MP’s husband about gambling site shares
data.description: Bhumjaithai Party MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband met with Department of Special Investigation (DSI) investigators on Tuesday to provide information about his shareholding in the online gambling website Shuffle.com.

data.title: Justice minister details progress in MP Suchada's gambling website case
data.description: Justice Minister Rutthapon Naowarat has denied suggestions he was attempting to whitewash Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband over their suspected links to an online gambling network.

data.title: Chinese students ripped off by condo agents
data.description: A group of Chinese students on Tuesday filed a police complaint against a condominium agent they had paid about 10 million baht to arrange rented accommodation, but had failed to do so.

data.title: Bangkok council seeks cable solutions
data.description: Bangkok councillors have approved a special committee to study solutions for disorganised communication cables, including relocating them underground on suitable roads, with a 90-day deadline for its review.

data.title: City Hall extends flood aid registration period as delays mount
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has extended the deadline for flood victims to file the paperwork needed for financial assistance for another month, until the end of November.

data.title: Five tonnes of cannabis buds seized in Bangkok
data.description: Police have arrested four Myanmar workers and their Vietnamese boss and seized five tonnes of cannabis buds at a rented house in Bangkok, and caught five Thais on a central plains highway with 284 kilogrammes of crystal meth.

data.title: Heroin bound for Australia seized
data.description: SAMUT PRAKAN: Narcotics officers have seized about 7kg of heroin concealed in instant-drink sachets in two parcels destined for Australia.

data.title: Council seeks cable solutions
data.description: Bangkok councillors have approved a special committee to study solutions for disorganised communication cables, including relocating them underground on suitable roads, with a 90-day deadline for its review.

data.title: Virgin Atlantic lands in Phuket
data.description: Thailand welcomed Virgin Atlantic's inaugural direct flight from London Heathrow to Phuket on Monday, as advance bookings from the UK rose 17.5% ahead of the high season.

data.title: New pilot zone to curb bribery
data.description: The government will use Bangkok's Khao San Road as a pilot zone to tackle bribery involving entertainment venues and speed up action against corrupt officials.

data.title: Group calls for halt to social security advisers' selection
data.description: The Progressive Social Security group has called for a halt to the selection of advisers to the Social Security Board, saying the selection committee must be named by the newly elected board.

data.title: House re-invites MP Suchada to explain gambling claims
data.description: A House committee will again invite Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband to explain alleged links to online gambling and a reported bribery offer at its meeting on Thursday, chairman Rangsiman Rome said on Monday.

data.title: Deadlock over debate time persists
data.description: The government and opposition remain at odds over the duration of the upcoming no-confidence debate, with the government proposing three days and the opposition holding firm on its demand for five.

data.title: Orange Line trials to start late next year
data.description: The eastern section of the Orange Line MRT is slated to open for trial runs starting from December next year, with fare collection set to begin in January the following year.

data.title: New Cold War tests Thai choices
data.description: A new Cold War is emerging as the United States and China compete from trade and finance to outer space, scholars and senior journalists have warned, urging Thailand not to pick sides too soon.

data.title: Minister orders checks over pollution complaints
data.description: Industry Minister Varawut Silpa-archa on Monday ordered further factory inspections and water sampling in Prachin Buri after residents complained of pollution, pledging that any action would comply with the law.

data.title: Digital wallets lead to Cambodia scam
data.description: Police traced cryptocurrency transactions across dozens of anonymous digital wallets to identify a money-laundering network linked to scam operations in Cambodia, leading to 39 arrests and the seizure of assets worth more than 500 million baht.

data.title: NSC steps up southern safeguards
data.description: The National Security Council (NSC) is stepping up preventive measures in the southern border provinces alongside peace talks, seeking to prevent further incidents and rebuild public trust.
